audit.whatIsWrong: win[3] said Skill, win[4] and win[6] said Trundle, win[5] said Skill — yet all four captions describe Kayle kiting outside his reach, out-poking him and melting him at 16.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Trundle,Trundle,Trundle,Kayle,Kayle,Kayle,Kayle at 58.33% over 180 games, and the Trundle-side mirror explicitly handed Kayle the first-item and two-item stages.
audit.corrected: Rows 3-6 set to Kayle in both layers with ratings to match.

audit.why: Levels 1-3 Trundle, level 6 ranged form plus Divine Judgment, Nashor's, and level 16 are the right four windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Subjugate was described as stealing 'armor and MR'; Chomp's auto-reset was never mentioned; King's Tribute was absent entirely.
audit.why: Riot text: Subjugate steals a percent of the target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance immediately and doubles the stolen amount over 4 seconds, 120/100/80s. Chomp is a 3.5s auto-attack reset that saps attack damage and slows. King's Tribute heals him whenever a unit dies near him, and Frozen Domain increases his healing from all sources.
audit.corrected: Health added to the Subjugate steal with its doubling and cooldown; Chomp's reset stated as the wind-up tell; King's Tribute and the healing amp added to early with the Grievous Wounds cue.

edits.before: His Q bite shaves your AD and his W keeps him topped up while you have one W heal and short melee autos — concede the trade, do not contest it.
edits.after: Chomp resets his auto every 3.5s and saps your AD while Frozen Domain tops him up — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step back.

edits.before: Trundle is genuinely scary pre-6, far more than most melee. His W heal-zone lets him out-sustain you and brawl indefinitely, and his Q bite even shaves a little of your attack damage on each trade — brutal when your whole kit rides on autos that are still melee and weak this early. Do NOT walk into auto range to fight him. Concede CS at melee range, last-hit with Q poke from max distance, eat a little chip, and just survive. You have no answer to his sustain until your passive goes ranged at 6.
edits.after: Trundle is genuinely scary pre-6, far more than most melee. Frozen Domain raises his healing from every source and lets him brawl indefinitely, King's Tribute heals him off each dying minion, and Chomp shaves your attack damage on every bite — brutal when your kit rides on autos that are still melee this early. Do NOT walk into auto range to fight him. Concede CS, last-hit with Q poke from max distance, and get Grievous Wounds before you ever contest a brawl. You have no answer to his sustain until 6.

edits.before: You take over hard once items roll in — at 16 every auto fires an AoE wave and your E's percent-HP shred chews through even his drain-tank pool. But respect his R: Subjugate steals a chunk of your armor and MR and heals him off you, so a sloppy facecheck or a missed kite lets him flip a duel you should win. Stay at range, never get pillared into a wall, and burst him under your own R before his ult sustain stabilizes the fight. He out-scales a Darius, so close it cleanly rather than coinflipping the 1v1.
edits.after: You take over hard once items roll in — at 16 every auto fires an AoE wave and your E's percent-HP shred chews through even his drain-tank pool. But respect Subjugate: it steals your health, armor and MR, and the stolen amount doubles over 4 seconds, so a sloppy facecheck or a missed kite flips a duel you should win — 120s at rank 1. Stay at range, never get pillared into a wall, and burst him under your own R before that steal matures rather than coinflipping the 1v1.

edits.before: Pop R to strip your armor/MR and out-sustain you through your single W heal
edits.after: Pop R to steal your health, armor and MR, then out-sustain your single W heal

edits.before: Steals your stats. Avoid the brawl. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Steals health, armor and MR, and it doubles over 4s. 120s at rank 1.

notes: Subjugate steals health as well as resistances and the amount doubles over 4 seconds — the page only mentioned resistances. Chomp is an auto-attack reset, so his burst tell is the wind-up.
